task_context.problem_statement: Given $\frac{x}{y}=\frac{10}{4}.$ If $y = 18$, what is the value of $x$?
task_context.reference_solution: Replacing $y$ with $18$, we have $\dfrac{x}{18} = \dfrac{10}{4}$. Multiplying both sides of the equation by $18$, we have $x=\frac{10}{4}\cdot 18=\frac{180}{4}= \boxed{45}$.
